g.text: CPFriendFinder — Sequence — Send Image/Text and Edit Direct Text
Clear composer immediately; keep recoverable draft
No message-history row. Uploaded image object remains in storage.
Save message and mark sender read

Check active member / sender / room / type / not deleted
Replace text in existing message node
